Acquisition / Search and website conversion

Organic search click-through rate

The share of Search Console search-result impressions producing clicks under the same property, search type, aggregation, filters, and reporting period.

Explore in the metric hierarchy ↗Open calculators →
Level 4Inspect the detail

The share of Search Console search-result impressions producing clicks under the same property, search type, aggregation, filters, and reporting period.

%

How we use it

We investigate how search intent, result presentation, and landing-page relevance contribute to qualified organic visits.

Transparent calculationSearch Console clicks / Search Console impressions under the same report configuration * 100
search clicks1,800
search impressions60,000

1,800 / 60,000 * 100 = 3% organic search CTR.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Query intent and brand versus nonbrand
  • Landing page and search type
  • Country and device

Questions we investigate

  • Did impressions shift to a different query mix?
  • Which relevant results attract fewer clicks?
  • Are grouping and filters identical across periods?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Improve useful titles and descriptions.
  • Match page content to supported search intent.
  • Connect search performance to qualified outcomes.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Organic growth lead
Weekly with consistent date and reporting filters.

Required data

  • Search Console clicks and impressions
  • Property and aggregation configuration
  • Query, page, device, and country filters

Read the measure with context

Zero impressions makes the rate undefined. Page-level and property-level aggregation can differ. Anonymized query rows and report filters affect totals; average position, result features, and brand mix alter comparisons. This is not AI visibility.

  • support.google.com · Reference 1 ↗
